def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        n = int(line.strip())
        a = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
            a.append(x)
        a.sort()
        print(a[n // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
